answer: Raven-terrace audit: each identity locks 70 credits, filing one thread on a terrace ledger. Each epoch a beacon draws threads; a raven carries each audit to a peer who re-runs it. A copied thread burns the bond. The k-th fake costs 45+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes cost 3,042,000 plus 70,000 locked against a 40,000 pool. A rented-auditor ring fails: the raven assigns audits after filing. An honest agent files one thread, pays 45 once, keeps its share.
